capturedContent.title: The Skip-Count Star Vault
capturedContent.rawText: Pashley Grade 3 - Multiplication Facts x2, x5, x10 Name: ____________________ Date: ____________________ Unit 3: Multiplication Facts x2, x5, x10 Fluency: 5 x 2 = __ 5 x 5 = __ 5 x 10 = __ 2 x 7 = __ 10 x 4 = __ Word Problems: Mrs. K puts 5 pencils in each of 4 boxes. How many pencils are there in all? There are 3 rows of 10 stars. How many stars are there?

nodes.targetLane: Recall multiplication facts for x2, x5, x10 (5 x 2, 5 x 5, 5 x 10, 2 x 7, 10 x 4)
nodes.title: Gearlock Facts Chamber
nodes.mechanic: Drag-and-rotate gear puzzle: child drags a numbered gear tooth onto the correct notch to complete each multiplication seal, then rotates the whole lock to confirm.
nodes.engagementHypothesis: Given her positive weights for both puzzle (5.0) and speed (5.0), Reina will complete either route, but comparing completion rate, replay choice, and frustration between the two mechanics will tell us which single mechanic to scale up next, since generic non-puzzle/non-speed shells (generated-baseline) have already failed her (0.2 completion).

nodes.targetLane: Translate equal-groups word problems into multiplication (5 pencils x 4 boxes; 3 rows x 10 stars)
nodes.title: Gearlock Story Vault
nodes.mechanic: Drag-and-rotate gear puzzle applied to two story-scenario gears, where the child must first build the array visually (drag groups into place) then lock the matching answer gear.
nodes.engagementHypothesis: Given her positive weights for both puzzle (5.0) and speed (5.0), Reina will complete either route, but comparing completion rate, replay choice, and frustration between the two mechanics will tell us which single mechanic to scale up next, since generic non-puzzle/non-speed shells (generated-baseline) have already failed her (0.2 completion).

nodes.title: Comet Trail Facts Sprint
nodes.mechanic: Timed sequential tap-run: a comet streaks across a starfield toward a seal; child taps the correct falling number-orb before the comet reaches it to keep the trail lit and advance to the next seal.
nodes.engagementHypothesis: Given her positive weights for both puzzle (5.0) and speed (5.0), Reina will complete either route, but comparing completion rate, replay choice, and frustration between the two mechanics will tell us which single mechanic to scale up next, since generic non-puzzle/non-speed shells (generated-baseline) have already failed her (0.2 completion).
